items.title: Cross-Validation in Machine Learning: How K-Fold, Stratified, and Time-Series Splits Work
items.summary: Cross-Validation in Machine Learning: How K-Fold, Stratified, and Time-Series Splits WorkCross-validation is a way to test a machine learning model on many different slices of your data instead of trusting a single train test split. It answers one question: does this model actually generalize, or did it just get lucky with the split it was given?A single split can mislead you in both directions.
